description: Defines the dl_csi_rs_pdu_builder class, a builder for configuring CSI-RS PDU parameters in a 5G NR protocol implementation, based on specifications in SCF-222 v4.0 section 3.4.2.3.

classes.name: dl_csi_rs_pdu_builder
classes.description: A builder class for setting parameters of dl_csi_rs_pdu objects related to CSI-RS resource configuration, frequency, time, resource blocks, BWP, and TX power.

methods.name: set_csi_resource_config_parameters
methods.description: Sets CSI-RS resource configuration parameters: type, row, cdm_type, and scrambling_id.

methods.name: set_frequency_domain_parameters
methods.description: Sets frequency domain parameters: frequency allocation mask and density.

methods.name: set_time_domain_parameters
methods.description: Sets time domain parameters: symb_L0 and symb_L1.

methods.name: set_bwp_parameters
methods.description: Sets BWP parameters: subcarrier spacing, cyclic prefix, and resource block interval.

methods.name: set_tx_power_info_parameters
methods.description: Sets transmission power control parameters: offset and offset SS profile.
